_comment: The galactic council (open fix 96's id 70), work order 270. Geometry is screens/council/clgeom.py, the drawing cldraw.py; the marks name every difference from the original, each held by check 090zzzzb and named in dev:doc/state/council.md.

marks.transcription_council: TRANSCRIPTION (work order 270) — the council's steps, numbers and words as the engine holds and formats them (open fix 96): the three top lines and the message as Draw_Main_Council_Screen prints them (council.cpp:148-211), the vote and the ruling as Get_List_Field builds them (:213-281, :598-675); a click while it waits is its full-screen field (:72-99), a list item its field.
marks.deviation_no_chamber: DEVIATION — the chamber (COUNCIL.LBX's file animation), the members' portraits round the hall and the nominees' figures are not drawn; the nominees are panels and the members rows, each in its player's map colour, the member voting now lit.
marks.hd_extension_council_labels: HD EXTENSION — the panels' labels (NOMINEE, VOTES RECEIVED, OWN VOTES, COUNCIL MEMBERS, VOTES, ELECTED) and the hint 'Click to continue' while the game waits for a click; the original's chamber says them by its pictures.
marks.hd_extension_shell: HD EXTENSION — the screen shell (decisions 86-90): GALACTIC COUNCIL on the plate, the top lines, the hall and the message as panels of the content rectangle.
